This petition is filed by accused Nos.2 to 8 with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings in C.C.No.7129/2023 pending before the I Additional Civil Judge (Jr. Dn.) and JMFC Court, Gulbarga, arising out of Crime No.68/2023,
registered by Kalababuragi City Women Police Station, Kalaburagi City, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that, the petition may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioners to file necessary applications seeking their discharge before the trial Court.

He submits that, since the petitioners are all residents of Goa, they may be permitted to appear before the trial Court, virtually and accused No.1 has been already granted such a relief by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Transfer Petition (s) (Civil) No(s).2646/2023.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:805 3.
Learned counsel for the respondents does not seriously oppose the prayer made by the petitioners.
4. Their submission is placed on record.

5. The petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioners to file necessary application before the trial Court, seeking their discharge and the same shall be considered by the trial Court on its merits.

The trial Court shall permit the petitioners to appear virtually on the dates of hearing,
unless their physical appearance is absolutely necessary before the said Court.
6. With the aforesaid observations, the petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
(S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE SVH CT:PK Rajendra Malleshappa Pujari And Ors vs The State And Anr on 4 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10179897/
